guidance_fy26.src: Q3 FY26 release (8-K Ex. 99.1, 29-Jul-2026): FY26 guidance raised (issued 24-Nov-2025; raised 2-Feb-2026, 29-Apr-2026 and 29-Jul-2026)
guidance_fy26.history: 24-Nov-2025: sales +7-12%, EPS $7.50-8.00, FCF $300-350m, capex ~$290m, shares ~61m, ETR ~22%; Aerospace +9-15% / 22-23% margin; Industrial +5-9% / 14.5-15.5%. 2-Feb-2026: sales +14-18%, EPS $8.20-8.60; Aerospace +15-20%; Industrial +11-14% / 16-17%. 29-Apr-2026: sales +20-23%, adjusted EPS $9.15-9.45, shares ~61.5m; Aerospace +21-24% / 23-23.5%; Industrial +18-20% / 18-18.5%. 29-Jul-2026: adjusted EPS $9.30-9.50, adjusted ETR ~22.5%; Aerospace +21-23% / ~23.5%; Industrial +19-21% / ~19%; sales, FCF, capex and shares unchanged.

restructuring.china_oh: 8-K Item 2.05 (15-Jan-2026): wind-down of the China on-highway natural gas truck business (Industrial) by end of FY26; pre-tax charges ~$20-25m ($15-20m cash). Q3 FY26 10-Q: $14.2m recognised in 9M FY26; no further significant charges expected in FY26.
restructuring.servo_valve: Q3 FY26 10-Q: servo-valve line moved from Santa Clarita, CA to Rockford, IL (announced 31-Mar-2026); $1.9m charged in 9M FY26; ~$15m in total, substantially complete by end of calendar 2027.
restructuring.santa_clarita: 8-K Item 2.05 (21-Sep-2026; Board approval 15-Sep-2026): Santa Clarita, CA production moved to Spartanburg, SC; legacy commercial rotorcraft, land-systems and business-jet product lines and the campus to be sold (close expected FY27). Cumulative pre-tax charges ~$34-47.5m (severance $23-29m, contract termination $10-16.5m, other $1-2m); ~$1m non-cash; recognised through Dec-2027.
restructuring.model: Q4 FY26E $6m (servo valve + start of Santa Clarita); FY27E $30m, FY28E $15m, FY29E+ 0 (Santa Clarita mid-point ~$41m + servo valve ~$13m remaining). All excluded from adjusted earnings (company definition).

deals.valve_research: Valve Research & Manufacturing (Jet Research Development, Inc.), Aerospace; closed 1-Apr-2026; consideration $120.7m net of cash (Q3 FY26 10-Q Note 10). Preliminary PPA: receivables $7.0m, inventories $7.5m, PP&E $13.1m, goodwill $69.3m, intangibles $35.7m (15-year life), other $0.1m; liabilities $12.1m.
deals.safran_ema: Safran electro-mechanical actuation business (Canada, US, Mexico), Aerospace; closed 21-Jul-2025; consideration $40.3m (Q3 FY26 10-Q Note 10).
deals.ontic_pilot_controls: Sale of the Aerospace pilot controls product line to ONTIC for $180.0m (definitive agreement 15-Apr-2026; close expected FY27, accounting gain expected). Held for sale at 30-Jun-2026: assets $20.0m, liabilities $3.6m (Q3 FY26 10-Q Note 10). Revenue of the product line not disclosed.
deals.santa_clarita_lines: Sale of Santa Clarita legacy product lines and campus (8-K 21-Sep-2026); price and revenue not disclosed.

2018.names: L'Orange GmbH and related entities (fuel-injection systems; Industrial) - closed 1-Jun-2018: cash paid $780.4m less acquired cash $9.3m = purchase price $771.1m (preliminary allocation, FY2018 10-K Note 4)
2018.src: FY2018 10-K (filed 13-Nov-2018) Note 4: receivables $26.538m + inventories $72.392m (incl. $16.324m fair-value step-up) + other current $1.385m; deferred tax $166.927m + other noncurrent $40.922m. Financed with $400m private-placement notes, cash and the revolver.

Q3-26.src: Q3 FY26 10-Q (filed 30-Jul-2026) Note 10: receivables $7.026m + inventories $7.533m = current assets

Q4-25.src: Q3 FY26 10-Q Note 10 (receivables $6.103m + inventories $11.833m + other current $3.125m; accrued $4.447m + payables $0.588m + income tax $0.189m). Goodwill shown before the $0.931m Q1 FY26 working-capital adjustment.

debt.at_2026_06_30: Total debt $1,341.9m: revolver $592.4m (Third A&R credit agreement, $1.0bn, matures 28-May-2031; SOFR + 0.875-1.75%; 4.73% effective), term loan $250.0m (28-May-2026, matures 28-May-2031, SOFR + 0.875-1.75%), private-placement notes ~$497m (Series M 1.12% EUR due Sep-2026; N 1.31% EUR Sep-2028; O 1.57% EUR Sep-2031; Q 4.35% $85m May-2027; R 4.41% $75m May-2029; S 4.46% $75m May-2030; T 4.61% $80m May-2033), finance leases $2.2m.
debt.new_notes: Note Purchase Agreement 19-Aug-2026 (8-K 21-Aug-2026): $450m senior unsecured notes closing 30-Sep-2026 - Series U 5.34% $150m due 30-Sep-2029, Series V 5.39% $150m due 30-Sep-2030, Series W 5.64% $150m due 30-Sep-2033.
debt.src: FY2025 10-K Note 15 (notes by series at 30-Sep-2025); Q3 FY26 10-Q Note 15; 8-Ks of 28-May-2026 and 21-Aug-2026.
debt.notes_jun26_note: Current portion of long-term debt $131.8m + long-term debt $617.7m - term loan $250.0m - finance leases $2.2m (Q3 FY26 10-Q balance sheet and lease note).

buyback: 2026 Authorization (Nov-2025): up to $1.8bn over three years to Nov-2028; $513.9m used in 9M FY26 and $1,286.1m remaining at 30-Jun-2026 (Q3 FY26 10-Q Part II Item 2). 2024 Authorization ($600m) completed Nov-2025.
dividend: Quarterly dividend $0.32 declared 24-Jun-2026 and 15-Sep-2026 (8-Ks 25-Jun-2026, 16-Sep-2026; payable 3-Sep-2026 and 3-Dec-2026).

price.note: Weighted average price paid per share for shares repurchased 1-30 June 2026 (Q3 FY26 10-Q Part II Item 2, Issuer Purchases of Equity Securities) - the latest share price in an SEC filing; update to market.
